unit: Area of Study 1: Recording and production techniques
outcome: Use core and advanced functions of a digital audio workstation.

unit: Area of Study 1: Recording and production techniques
outcome: Describe other programming environments such as MIDI or OSC and the impact of new software on production.

unit: Area of Study 1: Recording and production techniques

unit: Area of Study 1: Recording and production techniques
outcome: Compare dynamic, condenser and ribbon microphones.

unit: Area of Study 1: Recording and production techniques
outcome: Compare polar patterns, proximity effect, frequency and transient response, and sensitivity.

unit: Area of Study 1: Recording and production techniques

unit: Area of Study 1: Recording and production techniques

unit: Area of Study 1: Recording and production techniques

unit: Area of Study 1: Recording and production techniques

outcome: Use editing functions such as normalising and inverting waveforms.

outcome: Correct rhythm by cutting and moving notes or audio quantise.

outcome: Describe reverb tail, pre-delay and RT60.

outcome: Trace signal path and types of connectivity in recordings.

outcome: Compare jack and XLR leads, balanced connections and DI boxes for avoiding hiss, hum and rumble.

outcome: Explain impedance and mic, line and instrument signal levels.
